# Carlton Davis Consulting

Carlton Davis is a Nashville AI trainer, speaker, and business advisor who helps small and midsize business owners, leaders, and teams use ChatGPT and Gemini. He helps organizations choose useful applications, improve everyday workflows, check AI results, and adopt AI responsibly.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.carltondavisconsulting.com/): Overview of Carlton Davis Consulting, AI training and workshops, speaking and events, AI strategy and advisory support, Carlton Davis's background, featured media, and contact options.
- [AI Workshops & Speaking](https://www.carltondavisconsulting.com/ai-workshops-speaking/): Details about workshops, speaking sessions, team training, session topics, audiences, and frequently asked questions.

## Services

- AI Training & Workshops: Practical sessions that teach business owners, leaders, and teams to use ChatGPT and Gemini for communications, document summaries, brainstorming, and everyday business tasks.
- Speaking & Events: Keynotes, panels, and facilitated sessions that explain what AI can do, where it falls short, and how it is changing everyday business work.
- AI Strategy & Advisory: Guidance for identifying useful AI applications, assessing workflows, prioritizing opportunities to save time, choosing tools, and creating a clear adoption plan.

## Who it is for

Business owners, leadership teams, small and midsize companies, chambers and business associations, workforce and nonprofit partners, conferences, boards, and leadership groups.
